name: any-llm

finish.primary: choices[0].finish_reason; error.completion.choices[0].finish_reason on finish-reason errors. Responses status / incomplete_details.reason; completed with function_call output means tool_calls; refusal parts mean refusal. No separate raw finish.

text.primary: choices[0].message.content; streaming choices[0].delta.content; error.completion.choices[0].message.content; Responses output message output_text parts or response.output_text.delta

tool_calls.primary: choices[0].message.tool_calls; streaming choices[0].delta.tool_calls joined by index; error.completion.choices[0].message.tool_calls; Responses function_call items use call_id, name and arguments; streaming output_item.added and argument deltas joined by output_index; arguments read with json.loads

usage.primary: usage.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; also error.completion.usage on finish-reason errors; Responses usage.input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens

structured.primary: response_format is a Pydantic model built from the input schema; choices[0].message.parsed is the parsed output; Responses output_parsed from response_format is reported only on return

stream.primary: ChatCompletionChunk iterator ending without error; last finish reason and last usage-bearing chunk; Responses final event (response.completed, response.incomplete or response.failed) and no error

config_notes: any-llm rejects a typed response_format with stream=True; structured Responses use the non-stream path.
